title: PAR-20/7G.3 FIELDLIST NOD root alias refusal

finding.source: hasCompleteAutoCadFieldGraph() required exactly one canonical ACAD_FIELDLIST edge to the typed FIELDLIST object but did not reject an additional differently named NOD edge to that same object.
finding.coverageGap: The generated FIELD graph refusal matrix did not include same-target NOD aliasing for the direct FIELDLIST object.
finding.scope: FIELDLIST direct-object NOD root alias refusal only; the target is not a DICTIONARY and is intentionally not passed through the generic dictionary-root helper.

implementation: Extended hasCompleteAutoCadFieldGraph() to refuse a noncanonical NOD edge targeting the FIELDLIST handle.
Added an ACAD_FIELDLIST_ALIAS case to the existing generated complete/wrong-owner/missing-target FIELD graph matrix for ASCII and Binary.
The alias case must fail graph closure and preserve the seeded destination; no new executable or CTest was added.
